patches.summary: Add read-only browser-backed Squarespace account dashboard commands for domains, DNS records, email forwarding, registrar metadata, Google Workspace pricing, and billing terms.
patches.reason: Squarespace's official Commerce OpenAPI schema does not expose account domains, DNS records, email forwarding, or billing metadata. The account dashboard uses authenticated browser session APIs, so the CLI resolves public domain names through the dashboard byName endpoint and then uses returned IDs at runtime.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./..., printing-press verify, printing-press publish validate, and live browser-backed account checks across five managed domains passed. No account-specific IDs, cookies, or raw private payloads are committed.

patches.summary: Add friendly site, website, pages, and store-pages aliases over generated Commerce API website profile and store page commands.
patches.reason: Squarespace users and agents naturally ask for site or pages workflows rather than the generated 1-0 command group names. Aliases keep the official generated endpoints reachable through easier command names without changing the underlying API behavior.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... and printing-press verify passed with the alias commands present.
